caption: The drawing depicts a woven basket placed at the center of a plain, light-colored background. Inside the basket, there is a large figure of a rabbit, positioned to the right and facing left. The rabbit is rendered with careful shading to show texture and form, and its outline and details are clear. In the foreground of the basket, nestled around the base of the rabbit, there are several rounded objects resembling eggs. The basket itself has a decorative woven pattern around its sides, with crisscross and circular designs. The color palette of the drawing largely consists of muted shades of beige, brown, and gray, giving a monochromatic appearance. The signature "G. Yranoski" appears near the lower right corner of the image.
title: Covered Rabbit Dish
